parsed.main_gap: The refinement lemma’s upper-bound construction omits the crucial verification that the overlay creates paired cells using at most q−1 actual cuts.

errors.description: The asserted overlay construction is not proved. One must order the A- and B-intervals, truncate the A-row at s_B, and count at most |A|+|B|−1 overlay cuts; adding q−|A|−|B| bisections then gives q−1. This is straightforward but essential.
errors.quote: and use at most \(q-1\) cuts in total (standard; details omitted).

parsed.notes: All other arguments, including the drafting lemma, graph lower bound, subset-sum estimate, and binary construction, are coherent. Supplying the short overlay cut-count proof would make the solution complete.
